messages:
Rae: Quick moral dilemma: if you find a perfectly good muffin in the kitchen fridge, is it communal or evidence in a snack crime? :thinking_face:
Omar: Evidence. label it 'Do Not Eat' and take a photo. Dessert forensics is a sport. :camera:
Nina: Communal if it has a smiley sticker. otherwise evidence. also who keeps stealing the blue stapler?
kitchen-bot: Reminder: shared utensils should be washed after use. :sparkles:
Rae: tiny contest: best one-liner about office life wins the muffin (if communal verdict lands on me). ready, set, go.
Omar: "I put my laptop to sleep. now it hibernates my anxiety"
Nina: "My desk plant is the most reliable coworker. it never joins meetings"
Rae: "Accidentally hit 'reply all' and made three new pen pals."
Omar: I vote Nina for best one-liner. also stapler mystery remains unsolved.
Nina: I did not steal the blue stapler but I once coerced a paperclip into eloping.
Rae: consensus: muffin is communal. muffin shall be sacrificed to the productivity gods. :muffin:
kitchen-bot: Snack update: muffin claimed. :white_check_mark:
Omar: I'll bring decoy staplers tomorrow to throw off the thief.
Nina: please also bring tiny post-it confessions. mystery solving is a team sport.
Rae: ok muffin ritual complete. thanks for the laughs.
